requirements.requirement: The system must define a scoring schema containing at least three distinct clinical trial measures derived from clinical_trials_service.py fields.
The system must represent each measure with a name, description, input field mapping, and scoring function definition.
The system must define normalization rules that convert all measure outputs to a common numeric scale (e.g., 0–1).
The system must define a weighting configuration where each measure has an explicit weight value.
The system must ensure that the sum of all measure weights equals 1.0.
The system must define a deterministic composite score formula that combines normalized measures using the configured weights.
The system must define the composite score output structure including total score and per-measure contributions.
The system must ensure that the schema is serializable as a static configuration object consumable by backend services.
The system must define handling rules for missing or null measure inputs that result in a valid normalized value.
The system must define default fallback values for measures when required trial fields are absent.
The system must define validation rules that reject schemas with fewer than three measures.
The system must define validation rules that reject schemas where any measure lacks a normalization rule or weight.
The system must ensure that identical trial inputs produce identical composite scores under the schema (determinism).
The system must support inclusion of phase, status, and location-derived measures if present in clinical_trials_service.py outputs.
The system must define measure scoring functions as deterministic mappings without reliance on runtime randomness or external state.
The system must allow the schema to be extended with additional measures without breaking existing measure definitions.
The system must define clear semantic labels for each measure to support downstream explanation generation.
The system must ensure schema definitions are interpretable by LLM-based explanation components without additional transformation.
The system must ensure measure descriptions are human-readable and context-complete for use in generated explanations.
The system must define a consistent ordering of measures in the schema for deterministic explanation and display.
